title: NSE IPO: Exchange eyes revenue diversification beyond options trading
text: NSE IPO: Exchange eyes revenue diversification beyond options trading. NSE management says new businesses, SIFs, commodities and ETFs could diversify revenue, while clarifying it has not sought permission to trade its shares on NSE
